Solution: Replaced exact case-insensitive matching. Terms now matched trimws(tolower()) query glossary names—exact equality, substring matching.

title: glossary2 (development version)
text: Missing format argument kableExtra::kable(), causing unreliable format detection Hand-built anchor tags single quotes, Pandoc’s markdown parser reinterpreted autolinked tag wasn’t recognized raw HTML Use kableExtra::cell_spec(format = "html", link = url) safely build links proper HTML quoting Explicitly pass format = "html" ("latex" LaTeX output) kable() prevent format detection ambiguity
